'Comprehensive closure': Israel to shut down all West Bank crossings, Wafa reports
article.summary: 'Comprehensive closure': Israel to shut down all West Bank crossings, Wafa reportsIsraeli forces have tightened restrictions around the occupied West Bank city of Ramallah, closing roads and entrances to several towns and villages, Wafa news agency reported.The development comes after Israeli authorities decided to impose a “comprehensive closure” on the occupied West Bank and close crossings into the territory until Saturday for the Jewish holiday of Sukkot.Local sources told the agency that the entrance gate to Turmus Ayya, north of Ramallah, was closed and residents were “harassed”.Wafa also reported that entrances to Aboud, Nabi Saleh, Atara and Taybeh were closed, while military checkpoints were set up at the entrances to Yabroud and Ein Sinyah.

article.title: Israeli forces kill Palestinian in Gaza, arrest four farmers in West Bank
article.summary: Israeli forces kill Palestinian in Gaza, arrest four farmers in West BankIsraeli forces shot and killed a Palestinian man in the Jabalia refugee camp in northern Gaza, Wafa news agency reported, citing sources at Gaza City’s al-Shifa Hospital.Wafa also reported that several Palestinians, including a child, were wounded in an Israeli drone attack on the outskirts of Khan Younis in southern Gaza, while eastern parts of the city came under Israeli artillery fire.Israeli forces arrested four Palestinian farmers while they were harvesting olives on their land east of Tulkarem in the occupied West Bank, according to Wafa.The farmers were working near the Israeli settlement of Einav when they were detained.Wafa said more than 1,400 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza by Israeli forces since the ceasefire began last year.

article.title: Smotrich calls for doing in West Bank 'what we did in Gaza'
article.summary: Smotrich calls for doing in West Bank 'what we did in Gaza'Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich has called on Israel to “go to war” in the occupied West Bank and “do what we did in Gaza”.“I certainly have solutions” to the situation in the West Bank, he told a podcast on Ynet outlet.“I think we need to go to war in Judea and Samaria, to do there what we did in Gaza, to dismantle the Palestinian Authority, which is a terror authority,” he said.He also called on Israel to annex southern Lebanon and the areas of Gaza still under Israeli control.Smotrich has previously called on Israel to annex more than 80 percent of the occupied West Bank.  His campaign for next month’s election has frequently called for a significant expansion of illegal Israeli settlements in the territory.

article.title: US-led Board of Peace says Unrwa will have no role in Gaza
article.summary: US-led Board of Peace says Unrwa will have no role in GazaThe US-led Board of Peace has said the UN agency for Palestinian refugees, Unrwa, will have no role in Gaza, echoing a longstanding Israeli demand to sideline the organisation.The board, which has been tasked with overseeing the Gaza ceasefire and reconstruction, said it would work only with partners it considers “reliable” and capable of meeting the needs of Gaza’s population.It added that Unrwa does not meet that standard.The decision comes days after the board unveiled a multibillion-dollar plan to begin rebuilding Gaza, following years of Israeli military operations that have devastated the territory.Hamas has criticised the board’s decision to exclude Unrwa, which provides education, health care and other services to millions of Palestinian refugees.
